questions.q: What does the 20X factor theory claim you can achieve?
a: Twenty times more than you think
questions.why: It states you are capable of achieving twenty times more.

questions.q: Approximately how many thoughts does a person have each day according to Queen's University?
questions.why: The text cites about 6,200 daily thoughts.

questions.q: What is the first step to gaining total control over your thoughts?
questions.why: You should tame thoughts when you notice them losing control.

questions.q: Which emotion does the book say is natural but must be overcome for confidence?
questions.why: Fear is described as a natural emotion that can hinder confidence.

questions.q: What technique does the book suggest to stop mind chatter when visualizing goals?
